verdict.rationale: Justworks is a payroll and PEO SaaS. A product of this kind could plausibly offer an API or CLI for headless or CI automation, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only describes UI navigation flows and a Xero integration with an automatic invoice-sync option. That is an adjacent integration feature, not headless or CI operation, and the probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt both returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
